note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Build those first 3 starting with ledger first"; of the 21 countries read first: "It should cover across every country"; "Retry the blocked tax facts once all countries land"): the tax on a screen worker's pay in Mozambique: a resident's income tax, social contributions, what is withheld at source, a non-resident artiste's withholding, an author's treatment, VAT and the tax year. Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page. Re-read 2026-11-03 (Wave 2): every source that answered still says what is quoted, and its date is moved; no primary was reached.

figures.finding: A resident's income is taxed on an annual scale of 10% to MZN 42,000, 15% to 168,000, 20% to 504,000, 25% to 1,512,000 and 32% above (applied to the whole income less a deduction per band); a municipal tax is also withheld (MZN 510 in Maputo for 2024).
The tax year is the calendar year; returns are filed January to April of the following year and any balance paid by the end of May (employment) or June.

sources.said: The tax year is the calendar year.
Individual tax returns must be submitted from January to April of the year following the tax year.

figures.finding: Social security is 3% from the employee and 4% from the employer on monthly pay; foreign employees covered at home may be exempted.

sources.said: The employer contributes an amount equal to 4% of monthly salary, and the employee contributes 3% of monthly salary.

figures.finding: Employers withhold income tax monthly at the legal rates (0% to 32%) and pay it by the 20th of the following month.

sources.said: Employers withhold earned income tax on a monthly basis for work carried out in Mozambique at the WHT rates approved by law, which currently vary from 0% to 32%.

figures.finding: A non-resident's earned income is withheld by the payer at a definitive flat 20% in most cases.

sources.said: For non-Mozambican residents, the earned income tax is withheld and remitted by the employer or other payer at a definitive flat rate of 20% (in the majority of the income received).

figures.finding: From 1 January 2026 VAT's exemption and simplified regimes are gone, so a freelancer charges VAT from the first metical; a small taxpayer (turnover to MT 4,000,000) may opt instead for ISPC, at 12% on services or 15% on liberal professions, in place of VAT and IRPS.
figures.applies: A freelancer's fees; whether an actor's or a writer's fee is a 'service' or a 'liberal profession' under ISPC the law's examples don't say

sources.said: Lei n.º 10/2025, Artigo 53 (Disposições transitórias): "Os sujeitos passivos que estejam integrados nos regimes de Isenção e Regime de tributação simplificada passam a cumprir as obrigações materiais e formais nos termos da presente Lei." Artigo 3 (Revogação): "É revogado o número 8 do artigo 21 e as Subsecções I e II da Secção IV do Código do Imposto sobre o Valor Acrescentado". Artigo 5: "A presente Lei entra em vigor a 1 de Janeiro de 2026." Lei n.º 9/2025 (ISPC), art. 2(2)-(3): "... cujo volume de negócios anual seja igual ou inferior a 4.000.000,00MT. 3. A tributação dos sujeitos passivos no Imposto Simplificado para Pequenos Contribuintes é de carácter optativo." Art. 8(1): "b) à taxa de 12%, ... prestação de serviços, tais como, canalização, carpintaria ...; c) à taxa de 15%, ... profissões liberais, tais como, advogados, economistas, geólogos, engenheiros, contabilistas"; (3): "consideram-se profissões liberais as actividades exercidas com base em formação técnica ou científica especializada, regulamentada, ou não, por uma ordem profissional, incluindo os consultores."

figures.finding: The IRPS Code's own scale (art. 54) taxes annual taxable income at 10% to MZN 42,000, 15% to 168,000, 20% to 504,000, 25% to 1,512,000 and 32% above, the whole income at its top rate less the table's sum, which comes to the same as band by band; from the tax so reckoned a resident deducts MZN 1,800 a year for himself and MZN 600 to 1,800 for one to four or more dependants, never below nothing (art. 60 as Lei 20/2013 wrote it, from 1 January 2014).
figures.applies: The Code as enacted (Lei 33/2007) and as Lei 20/2013 amended art. 60, read 2026-11-03 in the Boletim's scans (art. 60 checked against the page image); Lei 11/2025 (from 2026) amends neither article (PwC's list), but acts from 2014 to 2024 weren't checked. PwC's 2026 table prints the same scale.

sources.said: Artigo 60 (Deduções relativas à situação pessoal e familiar) 1. À colecta do IRPS devida por contribuintes residentes em território moçambicano e até ao seu montante são deduzidos anualmente: a) 1.800,00MT por cada sujeito passivo; b) 600.00MT quando exista um dependente; 900,00MT quando existam dois dependentes; 1.200,00MT quando existam três dependentes e 1.800,00MT quando existam quatro ou mais dependentes, desde que não sejam sujeitos passivos deste imposto.
